Trump Invites Putin To G20 Summit
Secretary of State
Marco Rubio
confirmed Wednesday that the U.S. invited Putin to the G20 summit, scheduled for December in Miami.
He said another Trump-Putin summit "hasn’t been discussed," but Trump is "willing to engage and meet with virtually anyone."

"In order to solve problems you have to meet with people that you disagree with," Rubio said, adding that the G20 would give Putin "an opportunity for him to engage not just with the president but with other world leaders."
"The ideal would be a meeting in which there will be a result, an outcome," the Secretary of State said.
He added that Putin’s attendance at the G20 would give Trump and Putin "an opportunity for them to interact and talk."
